'''Cole Bozman Rebel Penny Pincher''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on Decipher Deck Designs.

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Cole Bozman]]
* '''Published:''' May 1996 (Decipher Deck Designs)
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Tatooine: Docking Bay 94|Premiere-L-tatooinedockingbay94.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Rebel Penny Pincher
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:Prem Rebel Penny Pincher Bozman LS 1996.txt |Download]]

== Strategy ==

Here's my Rebel penny-pincher deck (all commons).
